🎬 Karate Kid: Legends has just hit theaters, bringing together franchise icons Jackie Chan and Ralph Macchio to mentor a new generation in this latest installment . While the film offers high-octane martial arts sequences and nostalgic callbacks, a deeper examination reveals underlying spiritual themes that warrant discussion.

In this exclusive LED Live episode, a 2nd Degree Black Belt and former martial arts instructor delves into the film's portrayal of martial arts, exploring its connections to Eastern philosophies and potential spiritual implications. Drawing from personal experience and a Christian perspective, he addresses questions such as:

🥋 What are the spiritual roots of martial arts depicted in the film?
🧘 Does the movie promote philosophies that conflict with Christian teachings?
⚔️ How should believers approach martial arts in popular culture?

Whether you're a longtime fan of the Karate Kid franchise or new to its legacy, this reaction offers a thought-provoking analysis that goes beyond the surface.
